mcqs.question: In the Women’s section of the 46th Chess Olympiad 2026, which country won the gold medal?
options: China
Kazakhstan
India
Germany
mcqs.explanation: China won the gold medal in the Women’s section. Kazakhstan won silver and India won bronze; Germany’s medal was in the Open section.

mcqs.question: Which major achievement was led by Harmanpreet Kaur in 2026?
options: India’s second consecutive Asian Games T20 gold
India’s first Women’s ODI World Cup in 2025
India’s first lawn bowls gold at the Commonwealth Games
India’s gold medal in the Women’s section of the Chess Olympiad
mcqs.explanation: Harmanpreet Kaur led India to its second consecutive Asian Games T20 gold in 2026. India’s first Women’s ODI World Cup came in November 2025, while the other options refer to different sports and events.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about Harmanpreet Kaur:
Statement A: She was the first Indian woman to score a T20I century.
Statement B: She made her international debut in 2010.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true because Harmanpreet Kaur was the first Indian woman with a T20I century. Statement B is false: her debut was in 2009, not 2010.

mcqs.question:
Match the Harmanpreet Kaur captaincy milestone in List-I with the corresponding detail in List-II.

List-I
 a. First captaincy for India
 b. T20I captaincy
 c. ODI captaincy
 d. All-format captaincy

List-II
 i. 2023
 ii. T20 match against Pakistan at Guangzhou
 iii. 2016
 iv. 2022, after Mithali Raj
options: a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i
a-iii, b-ii, c-i, d-iv
a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii
a-i, b-iv, c-ii, d-iii
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-iii, c-iv and d-i. Harmanpreet first captained India in a T20 against Pakistan at Guangzhou, became T20I captain in 2016, ODI captain in 2022 after Mithali Raj, and all-format captain in 2023.

mcqs.question: Who chaired the IOC Coordination Commission for the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games?
options: Kirsty Coventry
Pierre de Coubertin
Mithali Raj
Harmanpreet Kaur
mcqs.explanation: Kirsty Coventry chaired the IOC Coordination Commission for the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games. Pierre de Coubertin was the founder of the IOC, while Mithali Raj and Harmanpreet Kaur are associated with Indian cricket.

mcqs.question:
Match the event or institution in List-I with the correct detail in List-II.

List-I
 a. First Summer Youth Olympic Games
 b. Previous Summer Youth Olympic Games before Dakar
 c. First Winter Youth Olympic Games
 d. IOC founding

List-II
 i. Innsbruck, 2012
 ii. Lausanne, 1894
 iii. Singapore, 2010
 iv. Buenos Aires, 2018
options: a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii
a-iv, b-iii, c-ii, d-i
a-i, b-ii, c-iv, d-iii
a-ii, b-i, c-iii, d-iv
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Singapore–2010, Buenos Aires–2018, Innsbruck–2012 and Lausanne–1894. Thus, the code a-iii, b-iv, c-i, d-ii is correct.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the disciplines at the Commonwealth Cue Sports Championship 2026 is incorrect?
options: English Billiards was one of the disciplines.
Snooker was one of the disciplines.
Carom was one of the disciplines.
Blackball was one of the disciplines.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Carom was one of the disciplines. The listed disciplines included English Billiards, Snooker, Heyball, 10-Ball Pool and Blackball; Carom was not listed.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): India’s first lawn bowls gold came in the Women’s Fours at the Birmingham Commonwealth Games.
Reason (R): The achievement took place in 2022.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and Reason are true. India’s first lawn bowls gold was won in the Women’s Fours at the Birmingham Commonwealth Games in 2022, and the year identifies when that achievement occurred.
